test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 30 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/293a92c11e3676578686b8ea8cab39337817e53f7cec50d421c03a03060b1add.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The center element of 1st row elements shift anticlockwise subsequently.

The rest of the elements shift clockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99c5963f4040d687db62be27ee49cb92a247bbe35b12e4451a0fede028cdf88f.png] 

2) Second box series →

The 1st column elements shift clockwise subsequently.

The 3dr column elements shift clockwise subsequently.

The center element is replaced by new element.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b459a5c6d3503a9f9f8f46daee5200ef1e1b1b9fc80566f11c23b42ce08348d4.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce4a6435c8f57e71424fc5565b925995d443bcf81e963ed8202f3a944776aaac.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
